attribution.reason: The recorded recipe puts zero weight on terminal and holding tip speed and only 1e-4 on velocity, and the tip is still moving at 0.635 m/s at the last recorded sample, so a weighting-driven residual tip speed is plausible; however raw weight magnitudes do not establish cost-term importance without observed contributions or scaling, and no counterfactual was run, so it is not established.

34 of 35 selections ended with raw status User_Requested_Stop against 1 Solve_Succeeded, with recorded policy stop reasons such as budget_best_feasible and relative_seed_improvement, and mean update 17.075 s versus a 0.01 s control period; this records early policy stops and wall-time overrun, but the retained signals do not show whether the accepted trajectories were inaccurate, so non-convergence as a settling cause stays unresolved.

Recorded effective horizons fall from 8 to 3 control intervals across updates 27-32, shorter than the recipe's configured horizon, and a shorter lookahead can limit how terminal deceleration is planned; the inventory records the per-update horizons but no replay separates horizon effects from weighting, warm-start/seed and model effects.

Matched one-step comparisons in the late window show projected GVS tip/velocity differences against the serial backend (0.0059-0.0077 m; 0.021-0.150 m/s) and recorded projection residuals near 2.4-2.9 rad/m, so model mismatch is a live candidate; the retained note states single execution and model comparisons do not establish a dominant cause.

The retained force-limit inventory lists 8 N per tendon for all six channels, while the requested tensions displayed for updates 27-34 peak at about 7.99 N (update 30, tendon 0) and do not exceed the limit; saturation is not indicated in these samples, but only a subset of updates was displayed, so it is not resolved either way.

facts.statement: Reach passed while sampled settling failed: terminal_error_m = 0.007643 m is within the 0.01 m reach tolerance and reach_passed = true, but sampled_settling_passed = false because late_max_speed_m_s = 1.5810 m/s and terminal_speed_m_s = 0.6352 m/s exceed the 0.02 m/s settling speed limit while late_max_error_m = 0.0581 m exceeds the 0.01 m position limit over the 0.05 s settling window.

In the sampled late window the tip error falls from 0.0581 m at t = 0.30 s to 0.007643 m at t = 0.35 s while tip speed stays between about 0.635 and 1.581 m/s, and matched one-step GVS predictions differ from the serial-backend endpoint by 0.0059-0.0077 m in tip position and 0.021-0.150 m/s in tip velocity, with recorded per-update GVS projection residuals of roughly 2.37-2.92 rad/m.

All 35 controller updates missed their deadlines (deadline_misses = 35; mean_update_s = 17.075 s versus control_period_s = 0.01 s); stopping_counts are User_Requested_Stop = 34 and Solve_Succeeded = 1; initialization_selected = 29 of 35 versus noninitialization_selected = 6; and recorded per-update effective horizons shrink from 8 control intervals (update 27) to 3 (update 32).

The recorded objective parameters place zero weight on terminal tip speed (terminal_tip_speed_weight = 0.0) and on holding tip speed (holding_tip_speed_weight = 0.0), with velocity_weight = 0.0001 and seed_speed_limit_m_s = 0.02 m/s; these are recorded magnitudes only and do not by themselves establish cost-term importance.
